name: BUG-01
observations: Fixed: Registry backup now persists to disk
Moved backup_mgr creation outside operation loop in apply_tweak
Added backup_mgr.save(backup_path) after all operations complete
cargo check passed, clippy errors are pre-existing
undo_tweak's load() will now find the persisted file

name: RegistryBackup
observations: Located in src/modules/registry/backup.rs
save() and load() methods already implemented correctly
new(_path) intentionally ignores path and returns default (by design)
backup_value() populates entries HashMap in RAM
restore_tweak_backup() writes originals back to registry

name: BUG-02
observations: Fixed: undo_tweak now async fn with spawn_blocking
Changed pub fn → pub async fn, wrapped all blocking ops in tokio::task::spawn_blocking
Added progress events: revert-start and revert-success
Fixed double-revert (BUG-15): tracks restored_keys HashSet to skip registry ops already restored from backup
State update moved outside spawn_blocking (follows apply_tweak pattern)
cargo check passed

name: BUG-14
observations: Fixed as part of BUG-02: undo_tweak now emits tweak-progress events
Emits revert-start at 0% and revert-success at 100%

name: BUG-15
observations: Fixed as part of BUG-02: double-revert prevented
restored_keys HashSet tracks which registry keys were restored from backup
revert_operations loop skips keys already in restored_keys

name: BUG-03
observations: Fixed: FileOperation now executes instead of silently skipping
Implemented FileOp::Delete (remove_file/remove_dir_all), Copy (fs::copy), Move (fs::rename)
Creates parent directories for Copy/Move if missing
Returns Err on failure so tweak is not falsely marked as applied
cargo check passed

name: BUG-04
observations: Fixed: compress_folder and decompress_folder now use spawn_blocking

cargo check passed

name: BUG-05

cargo check passed
